subject: Route experiments beta (Phase 1) — invite list + enablement plan
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 3, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Route experiments beta (Phase 1) — invite list + enablement plan

Team —

Attaching v3 of the beta invite list + a draft enablement checklist.

Proposed Phase 1 beta cohort (Feb 10–Feb 28):
1) Acme AI (design partner) — already deep in rollouts, wants model-variant A/B + latency guardrails
2) Northbridge (POC) — needs cost attribution per variant in Console
3) Helio Financial (security-driven) — wants audit trail evidence; OK if feature set is “MVP” as long as logging/export story is clear

Enablement proposal:
- Feature flag: route_experiments_beta (account allowlist)
- Regions: start us-east-1 only (maybe add eu-west-1 week of Feb 17 if stable)
- Console: creation wizard + results view behind flag; default guardrails enabled (soft-stop only)
- Comms: email invite + short enablement doc + office hours

Key questions / asks:
- Dylan/Chloe: do we have confidence in control plane + Console workflow stability for a Feb 10 enablement? Any blockers for “create/start/stop + basic results”?
- Logan: are the experiment attribution dimensions and rollups good enough to avoid “results not updating” issues? Any must-have instrumentation before we invite Northbridge?
- Sean: are you comfortable with on-call readiness if we keep scope to 3 accounts + 1 region initially? What are your go/no-go criteria?
- Connor: can you pencil the flag flips + account allowlists into the Feb release train plan (and confirm the cut lines)?

Timeline:
- Feb 5: finalize cohort + internal doc ready
- Feb 7: enablement checklist + support macros ready
- Feb 10: enable Acme + Northbridge
- Feb 12: enable Helio (after security touchpoint)

Attachments:
- route-experiments-beta-invite-list-v3.xlsx
- beta-enablement-checklist-v1.docx

Thanks,
Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Product, Console & Rollouts
Redwood Inference


From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 3, 2025 at 10:01 AM PST
Subject: Re: Route experiments beta (Phase 1) — invite list + enablement plan

Looks reasonable.

Eng readiness notes:
- Console flow (create → configure variants/splits → start/stop): in good shape behind the flag.
- Biggest risk is results freshness (rollups lag) and customer expectations around “real-time.” We should explicitly message that results are near-real-time with ~10–20 min aggregation delay.
- Strongly recommend we do us-east-1 only for week 1. Adding eu-west-1 on Feb 17 is fine if attribution drop rate stays low.

Chloe is tracking a couple perf issues on list-experiments API; shouldn’t block beta but might be noticeable if they create lots of experiments.

Also: Helio is likely to ask about hard-stop. We’re not ready to promise that broadly; we can frame auto-stop as “optional and gated” and keep default behavior soft-stop + notify.

-Dylan

—
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Lead, Console & Tooling
Redwood Inference


From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 3, 2025 at 10:36 AM PST
Subject: Re: Route experiments beta (Phase 1) — invite list + enablement plan

Telemetry/metrics readiness:
- Attribution fields ({route_id, experiment_id, variant_id, model_id, region}) are emitted end-to-end in us-east-1.
- We still see some attribution loss on streaming retries in staging (lower than before, but not zero). I’m OK to beta with Acme/Northbridge as long as we set expectations + keep an eye on the attribution drop dashboard.

Must-haves before Feb 10:
1) Dashboard link + baseline thresholds included in enablement doc (so Support/CS can self-serve when results look “blank”).
2) Confirm we’re using route template normalization (not raw paths) to avoid surprise cardinality.

Northbridge specifically:
- They care about cost per token deltas. We can provide cost/token + tokens/sec by variant, but we should highlight that cost is derived from usage + pricing tables (not “GPU cost”) so it matches invoice-style numbers.

If you want, I can add 3 bullets to the invite email about metric latency + what “quality” does/doesn’t mean in Phase 1 (since evals are optional).

-Logan

—
Logan Wright
Telemetry & Analytics
Redwood Inference


From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 3, 2025 at 11:14 AM PST
Subject: Re: Route experiments beta (Phase 1) — invite list + enablement plan

SRE view: 3 accounts + 1 region is OK.

Go/no-go criteria for Feb 10:
- Config propagation lag alert wired (even if alerting is set to “warning” severity initially)
- Runbook link in alert payload (or at least in the internal doc)
- Kill switch documented (flag off + router fallback behavior)

Also request:
- For beta, please keep “auto-stop” disabled by default. If we need it for Acme specifically, we can do a targeted enablement after a game day.

If we agree on the above, I’ll have one of the on-call captains do a 30 min review of the enablement checklist before the first account flip.

-Sean

—
Sean Gallagher
SRE Lead
Redwood Inference


From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 3, 2025 at 12:03 PM PST
Subject: Re: Route experiments beta (Phase 1) — invite list + enablement plan

+1 to this plan.

Two notes for Helio:
- Do not position this as “stat sig” or “automated decisioning.” It’s operational A/B with guardrails and deltas.
- Audit logging: we should be explicit about what is captured at create/update/start/stop and retention (and what is not yet exportable if anything is pending).

Marissa — please send a final version of the invite email copy for review before it goes out.

-Evelyn

—
Evelyn Hart
VP Product
Redwood Inference


From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 3, 2025 at 1:47 PM PST
Subject: Re: Route experiments beta (Phase 1) — invite list + enablement plan

Thanks all — incorporating the guidance.

Decisions / updates:
- Phase 1 cohort confirmed: Acme AI, Northbridge, Helio Financial.
- Region: us-east-1 only for first 7 days. Revisit eu-west-1 week of Feb 17 contingent on attribution drop + propagation lag dashboards.
- Guardrails: soft-stop default. Auto-stop OFF by default for beta.
- Messaging: results are near-real-time with ~10–20 min aggregation delay; no stat-sig claims.

Action items:
- Connor: please schedule flag flips + allowlists (Acme + Northbridge on Feb 10; Helio Feb 12) and add a rollback step to the release checklist. If you need a tracking ticket, use INT-1193 as the umbrella.
- Logan: please send me the exact dashboard URLs + recommended thresholds we should reference in the enablement doc.
- Sean: I’ll send the updated enablement checklist for your 30 min review by EOD Feb 6.
- Dylan/Chloe: please confirm any last-minute Console copy we should add around stickiness keys and “why results may look empty.”

I’ll draft the invite email copy and send to Evelyn for approval by Wednesday.

Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Product, Console & Rollouts
Redwood Inference
